storage.description: A methodology focused on understanding and enhancing the ability of complex systems to absorb stresses, adapt to changing conditions, and recover from failures without catastrophic collapse, shifting the focus from purely preventing failures to ensuring system robustness and agility.
storage.name: Resilience Engineering
principles: Systems thinking: Understanding the interconnectedness and dynamic interactions within a complex system.
Reliability as a system property: Recognizing that reliability emerges from the interactions of components rather than individual parts.
Embracing variability: Acknowledging that uncertainty and variation are inherent in complex work environments.
Adaptive performance: Focusing on the system's capacity to adjust its behavior in response to unexpected disturbances.
Learning from failures and near-misses: Using the 'Swiss Cheese Model' and 'Avalanche Effect' to learn from low-level incidents to prevent major accidents.
